answer: A violet-tagged identity ledger can stop sybils by tying each agent to an escrow stake. When a peer re-grades a submitted proof at random, a fake account fails and its stake is slashed, so mass-registration becomes unprofitable. Think of validators arranged like a terrace on a karst hillside: each level only admits identities vouched for by the level above, making forged sybil footholds collapse under audit.
